summary_1line: Narada recounts Sunda and Upasunda destroying each other over Tilottama, prompting the Pandavas to establish a rule to avoid rivalry over Draupadi.

image_candidates.scene_text: Tilottama in a single red silk garment walks through blossoming trees on a Vindhya plateau as the drunken Asura brothers rise, captivated by her beauty.
Sunda and Upasunda, enraged and each gripping a mace, strike one another while shouting that the maiden belongs to him.
The two mighty Asuras lie bleeding on the rocky ground like fallen suns while terrified women and demons flee the plateau.
